about_the_game:
A message arrives from your friend Sugimoto:
“I’m coming over.”
From that casual text, the night quietly begins to unravel.

I’m Coming Over is a chat-based horror adventure.
As the protagonist, you guide your friend through quiet city streets via smartphone directions.
But his words soon reveal contradictions—descriptions of places that shouldn’t exist, and eerie photos that never should have been taken.

Memories of death and loss resurface.
Then comes the knock at your door.

Was it truly your friend you were guiding… or something else entirely?

Fear behind the chat

  • Conversations unfold through a smartphone-like interface.

  • Casual exchanges slowly corrode the everyday.

The familiar made strange

  • Set in a tiny Tokyo apartment, familiar streets twist into an uncanny maze.

Friend… or something else

  • The one you trust gradually reveals an ambiguous and unsettling nature.

Choices shape your fate

  • Salvation or ruin—each word you choose leads to a different ending.

  • Will you uncover the truth?

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains intense horror sequences and unsettling imagery.
It may not be suitable for players who are disturbed by horror or grotesque content.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or later (Intel or Apple Silicon)
  • Processor: Apple M1 / Intel Core i5-8259U
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU / Intel Iris Plus 655
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in macOS compatible sound device
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or later (Intel or Apple Silicon)
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro or better / Intel Core i7-9750H or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 Pro GPU or better / AMD Radeon Pro 5500M or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in macOS compatible sound device
